excerpts.excerpt: Routine operations can change the runtime order or retained state that architectural pattern relationships require, without any code change.
After a policy plugin was reapplied or an edit allow rule was saved, a prohibited edit executed without policy evaluation even though the participating plugins were active.
a pattern relationship is a property of the running system and its history, so architects should evaluate it against the decision paths, state lifetimes and operation sequences their deployments use.
by default, they run in registration order until one answers without passing the call on
The same enabled plugins and final settings thus gave different policy coverage after different operations
